# `channel`

Something an action needs exclusive use of: an arm, the voice, attention (03 §6.2).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What the channel is called where a player is told of it, as in the reason an action cannot start. Left out, its id is shown.
